mechanism_narrative: Persistently depressed TRANSIT and WORKPLACES means indicate suppressed commuting and discretionary trips; this suppression continues into the next four weeks and pushes RETAIL_REC lower than its last four-week mean.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days while TRANSIT remains below -55 and WORKPLACES below -30.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays above +12 for two consecutive weekly means, at-home behavior is entrenched; this reduces non-essential retail trips and drives RETAIL_REC lower over the following week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL > 12 for two consecutive weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 7 days despite RESIDENTIAL remaining above +12 for two consecutive weekly means.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of deeply negative TRANSIT and WORKPLACES amplifies retail decline: when both are suppressed, fewer commuters and transit-linked shoppers reach retail zones, keeping RETAIL_REC below its last four-week mean.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than its last 28-day mean while TRANSIT < -60 and WORKPLACES < -35.

mechanism_narrative: In the Omicron-restriction regime characterized by RESIDENTIAL above +10 and TRANSIT below -55, essential GROCERY_PHARM holds up while discretionary RETAIL_REC falls; the restriction regime persists long enough to keep the four-week retail mean lower.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days while RESIDENTIAL stays above +10 and TRANSIT stays below -55.

mechanism_narrative: Post-holiday January seasonality depresses RETAIL_REC in the observed window; as the holiday trough fades and PARKS activity normalizes, retail footfall rebounds over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days while PARKS returns above -10 by week 2.

mechanism_narrative: Policy-driven workplace closures and remote-work guidance keep WORKPLACES below -40 and RESIDENTIAL elevated; as these measures are expected to ease by February, pent-up retail demand lifts RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES and RESIDENTIAL remain under these thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility has fallen from +9.9 to +1.1, indicating the end of a stockpiling and essential-trip surge; as grocery trips normalize, time and spending shift back to discretionary RETAIL_REC, lifting it within one week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is lower than its last 7-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM remains below +2.
